grammarFocus: 第一条件句；because / therefore；情态动词建议。
title: The Community Garden Project
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答16个问题。题目类型包括单选、填空、判断正误（True/False/Not Given）和匹配标题。填空答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有题目均为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。请仔细阅读每个问题，并根据短文内容作答。
passage:
A. The Green Street community wants to build a garden on an empty lot. The lot is dirty and has no plants. Last month, the community held a meeting. Many people came. They discussed the project. Some people were excited. Others were worried about the cost. The meeting lasted two hours. At the end, they voted to start the project.

B. The project leader is Mrs. Chen. She says, "If we work together, we can finish the garden in three months." She also says, "We need volunteers. If you have time, please help." The community needs tools and seeds. They also need money. Mrs. Chen suggests that people donate old tools. She says, "If you donate tools, we will save money." The community plans to ask local businesses for help. If businesses give money, the garden will have a water system.

C. The garden will have vegetables and flowers. People can grow their own food. Children can learn about plants. The garden will also be a place for neighbors to meet. Mrs. Chen says, "If we all do a little, the garden will be a success." The first work day is next Saturday. Everyone is welcome. Please bring gloves and a hat. If it rains, the work day will be cancelled. The community will announce a new date.

D. Some people are still worried. They think the garden will be too much work. Mrs. Chen understands. She says, "If you are busy, you can help once a month. Every little bit helps." The community will put a sign in the garden. The sign will thank all volunteers. The project starts soon. The community hopes it will bring people together.

questions.prompt: What does the Green Street community want to build?
questions.explanation: 短文第一句提到“The Green Street community wants to build a garden on an empty lot.”，因此答案是花园。
questions.evidence: The Green Street community wants to build a garden on an empty lot.

questions.prompt: How long did the meeting last?
questions.explanation: 文中明确说“The meeting lasted two hours.”，所以会议持续了两小时。
questions.evidence: The meeting lasted two hours.

questions.prompt: According to Mrs. Chen, if we work together, we can finish the garden in ______ months.
questions.explanation: Mrs. Chen说：“If we work together, we can finish the garden in three months.”，因此填three。
questions.evidence: If we work together, we can finish the garden in three months.

questions.prompt: What does Mrs. Chen suggest people donate?
questions.explanation: 文中提到“Mrs. Chen suggests that people donate old tools.”，所以她建议人们捐赠旧工具。
questions.evidence: Mrs. Chen suggests that people donate old tools.

questions.prompt: If businesses give money, what will the garden have?
questions.explanation: 文中说“If businesses give money, the garden will have a water system.”，因此如果企业捐款，花园将拥有供水系统。
questions.evidence: If businesses give money, the garden will have a water system.

questions.prompt: What can children learn about in the garden?
questions.explanation: 文中提到“Children can learn about plants.”，所以孩子们可以学习关于植物的知识。
questions.evidence: Children can learn about plants.

questions.prompt: The first work day is next ______.
questions.explanation: 文中说“The first work day is next Saturday.”，因此填Saturday。
questions.evidence: The first work day is next Saturday.

questions.prompt: What will happen if it rains on the work day?
options: The work day will be cancelled.
The work day will start later.
The work day will be longer.
answers: The work day will be cancelled.
questions.explanation: 文中明确说“If it rains, the work day will be cancelled.”，所以如果下雨，工作日将被取消。
questions.evidence: If it rains, the work day will be cancelled.

questions.prompt: What does Mrs. Chen say to people who are busy?
options: They can help once a month.
answers: They can help once a month.
questions.explanation: Mrs. Chen说：“If you are busy, you can help once a month.”，因此忙碌的人可以每月帮忙一次。
questions.evidence: If you are busy, you can help once a month.

questions.prompt: What will the sign in the garden do?
questions.explanation: 文中提到“The sign will thank all volunteers.”，所以标牌将感谢所有志愿者。
questions.evidence: The sign will thank all volunteers.

questions.prompt: The community meeting was held last month.
questions.explanation: 文中第一段说“Last month, the community held a meeting.”，因此该陈述为真。
questions.evidence: Last month, the community held a meeting.

questions.prompt: Mrs. Chen is the only person who supports the project.
questions.explanation: 文中提到“Some people were excited.”，说明不止Mrs. Chen一人支持，因此该陈述为假。
questions.evidence: Some people were excited.

questions.prompt: The garden will have a playground for children.
questions.explanation: 文中只提到花园将有蔬菜和花卉，孩子们可以学习植物，但没有提到游乐场，因此信息未给出。
questions.evidence: The garden will have vegetables and flowers. Children can learn about plants.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of Paragraph B?
options: The garden needs volunteers and donations.
answers: The garden needs volunteers and donations.
questions.explanation: B段主要讲述项目需要志愿者、工具、种子和钱，并建议捐赠旧工具和寻求企业帮助，因此主旨是花园需要志愿者和捐赠。
questions.evidence: We need volunteers. If you have time, please help. The community needs tools and seeds. They also need money.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of Paragraph D?
options: Some people are still worried, but Mrs. Chen encourages them.
The garden will have a sign.
The community hopes to bring people together.
answers: Some people are still worried, but Mrs. Chen encourages them.
questions.explanation: D段提到一些人仍然担心，但Mrs. Chen理解并鼓励他们，即使忙碌也可以每月帮忙一次，因此主旨是Mrs. Chen鼓励担心的人。
questions.evidence: Some people are still worried. They think the garden will be too much work. Mrs. Chen understands. She says, "If you are busy, you can help once a month. Every little bit helps."

questions.prompt: What should people bring to the work day?
questions.explanation: 文中说“Please bring gloves and a hat.”，因此人们应该带手套和帽子。
questions.evidence: Please bring gloves and a hat.

If it rains, the work day will be cancelled.

grammar.title: 第一条件句与情态动词建议
grammar.explanation: 第一条件句用来谈论将来可能发生的事情。它的结构是：If + 一般现在时，主语 + will + 动词原形。例如：If it rains, the work day will be cancelled. 情态动词如should, can, could用来提建议。例如：You should bring gloves. You can help once a month.
grammar.example: If we work together, we can finish the garden in three months.

questions.prompt: If you ______ busy, you can help once a month.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句中，if从句用一般现在时，主语是you，所以用are。
questions.evidence: If you are busy, you can help once a month.

questions.prompt: If businesses give money, the garden ______ a water system.
questions.explanation: 第一条件句的主句用will + 动词原形，表示将来结果。
questions.evidence: If businesses give money, the garden will have a water system.

questions.prompt: Mrs. Chen says, "You ______ bring gloves and a hat."
questions.explanation: should用来提建议，表示“应该”。
questions.evidence: Please bring gloves and a hat.

questions.prompt: If it rains, the work day ______ cancelled.
questions.explanation: 主句用will + 动词原形，这里是被动语态will be cancelled。
questions.evidence: If it rains, the work day will be cancelled.

part1: Do you like gardening? Why or why not?
What can people do to help their community?

What kind of plants would you like to grow?
speaking.part2: Describe a community project you would like to start. You should say: what the project is, why you want to start it, who can help, and what the result will be.
part3: Why do some people worry about community projects?
How can a community garden bring people together?
What should the government do to support community projects?
If you had more time, would you join a community project? Why?

transfer.writing: Write a short paragraph (about 100 words) about a community project in your area. Use first conditional sentences and modal verbs for suggestions. Explain what will happen if people help.
